subject: RECORD clause
notes: 'Integer-5 shall be greater than integer-4' - SR5 one general format over, and a separate row because the table's FORMAT column is re-derived from the standard's own bare FORMAT 1 / FORMAT 2 / FORMAT 3 division lines (RecordClauseRuleDriftTests.EveryRow_IsScreenedOnTheFormatTheStandardPrintsItUnder). Format 3 deliberately gets NO SR4-analogue: 13.18.43.4 GR18 says the size of each record 'is completely defined in the record description entry', so the standard states no rule bounding the descriptions by integer-4 and integer-5, and the negative golden asserts the record draws nothing while the clause is reported. The positive witnesses the boundary where SR9 must not fire (RECORD CONTAINS 4 TO 12 BYTES).
